༄༅/ /bla sgrub gnad kyi zhal shes shin tu gsang ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bla sgrub gnad kyi zhal shes shin tu gsang ba bzhugs so//

bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas// snyigs ma lnga bdo'i 'gro rnams kyis// bla ma mtshan ldan mi bsten par// dpe cha mthong nas gdams pa ston// brgyud pa med pa'i zab chos kyis// bdag gzhan bslu ba 'byung srid pas// de phyir gnad kyi man ngag 'ga'// zhal gyi pad+mar gab pa dag /brjed 'jigs yi ger bris pa yang*// sa bcad tho tsam las gzhan pa'i// zhib cha rnams ni zhal du gab// rtsa rlung rdo rje'i phreng ba yi// gzhan lus phyag rgyar bsten pa'i tshe// gnad kyi man ngag rnam pa lnga// 'dzin pa rgya mtsho gnas bcings nas// lus gnad sems skyil khu tshur gnyis// pus steng bzhag cing lag g.yas kyi// mtheb srin skam pas mchu yi 'og /kan+dha ra mgul ni legs pi ḍa btsir// dmigs pa dwangs ma dngul chu ltar// g.yo ba sna tshogs ku li shaṃ// lte bar bcing bsam dar cig bzhag /ldog pa rdo rje'i sgyogs chen ni// lus gnad de dang ldan pa'i ngang*// rgya mtsho ri sbyar she pha mje yis// khong 'dzum drag po nyer gcig bya// dmigs pa dwangs ma ku li shar rdo rje*// bcas pa steng du 'dzeg par bsam// mgrin pa lcags kyu khong bsgril ni// bsgrengs pa'i rkang bsnol lag bsnol gyi| |mtheb srin gyis ni rkang srin bzung*// rlung gnad phyi 'dzin madh+ya dbu ma sā ra btsugs// tshangs pa brgya byin gyen du bteg /rnam rgyal khang bzang ka ba la// shed bkur shed kyis 'then pa dang*// dmigs pa dwangs ma ku li sha// dbu ma'i nang brgyud khron chu ni// dpyangs thag gis drangs lta bur bsam// 'grems pa stobs can 'khor lo ni// gha ṭa bum pa gho ṇa gdong ngam kha bho ṭa'i sbyor rlung*// bsgrengs te rkang lag so sor 'khyud| |gcus pa'i rgya mtsho g.yas g.yon bskor// sgur te mthil bzhi sar phab cing*// bskor zhing gcus pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis// dmigs pa dwangs ma lus stod smad// kun la khrems pa'i 'dun pa yis/ */slar yang rdor skyil khu tshur ni// nu khar rdeg pa'i 'bebs gsum bya// rtsa mig gdab pa'i 'khrul 'khor ni// gyad bzhi ar gtad 'di lta ste// gha ṭa bum pa bkaṭaṃ gdong ngam kha su ṭa'i sbyor rlung*// 'grengs te rkang lag rab tu bsgrad// dbang lnga bsgrad cing gyen du gzir// slar yang bsdad cing khu tshur gyis| |gzhog drud nu khar rdeg pa dang*// zhags skyur dpung rdeg mda' 'gengs ni// gsum gsum bya zhing rkang pa yang*// brkyang brdab bya zhing de yi rjes// sems skyil lag gnyis zhags skyur gyis// 'bebs gsum bya zhing ha sprug bya// de tshe dwangs ma kun 'phel nas// rtsa mig ba spu'i khung bu dang*// tshangs bug nas ni rkang mthil bar// gang bar bsam zhing brjod med bsgom// /

gegs sel bde ba'i rdo rje'i nang*// chags med chags pa skye ba'i thabs// ba glang rwa co'i man ngag ni// ba glang rwa co ha nu 'gram pa la// gug cing skor skyes rwa yi rtse// zhib btags mar dang sbyar ba dang*// kar+ṇi ka lte ba la byugs pa na// 'dod chags me ltar 'bar bar 'gyur// / /gze ma bzhi sbyor man ngag ni/ /gze ma am+pa skyu ru ra gu ḍu tsi sle tres// shing mngar sbrang sbyar ril bu ni// rtag tu bsten na yon tan 'phel// / kha bsgyur gzhan phan snying po'i nang*// rdzas kyi gtum mo bya ba'i skabs// mtshan ldan thod par rdzas chang sbyar// khrog cig btung tshe lhag ma ni// bzhag na mi bskyar de dag la// drod ni brtan dang mi brtan pa'i// rten 'brel brtag pa zab mo mchis// zhes pa rdzas chang lhag med du// 'thung zhing ngoms na drod brtan la// bde ba 'bar zhing yon tan skye// de sogs rab yin ches bzang ngo// lhag ma ma lus ma ngom na| |drod brtan mchis kyang bde ba la// 'jig rten chags bde'i bar chad kyis// 'dzag pa'i gegs su 'gyur srid pas// de sogs brtag pa 'bring du bshad// lhag ma lus na ngan pa ste| |drod mi brtan cing bde ba chung*// gtum mo'i yon tan skye dka' bas// bsgrims shing gzab nas nyams len 'tshal// / mtshams med spyad dang mtshams sbyor ngan// bag chags med gsum de sogs la// lus bcos rba rlabs bcings pa yi// 'khrul 'khor rang dmigs 'pho ba ni// lnga par 'phye la khad nye ba'i// lus can gang de'i srog 'dzin ni// nyal gyis song tshe rba rlabs bzung*// rang gis dal gyis mnan byas nas// yul gyi srog 'dzin chad ma thag /btsir gyis mnan la las sbyor gyi// dmigs pa rang gis gsal btab nas| |hig gam phaṭa kyi shugs drag pos// spar zhing rtags dang bstun par bya// / tshil chen mar me'i rdzas dag la// brten nas 'od gsal 'dzin pa ni// tho rangs nam mkha' g.ya' dag tshe// tshil chen zhun gyi mar me dag

/che zhing gsal ba rang mdun bzhag /mal stan bde bar dak+ṣi ṇa g.yas*// 'og bstan 'phrog byed ltar sup+ta gzims// nyi zla mar me la gtad nas// rang gi sems dang mar me gnyis// bsres shing tha mal rtog pa spang*// nyi zla sprin gyis mi sgrib gnad// de tsha sha ya lu gnyid ga ta song ba// de yi mod la mūrtsatshi ta dran med du brgyal ba// de dag zla nyi'i 'od lta bur// dkar gsal cham gyis mthong ba dang*// rang rig 'od gsal rang ngo mthong*// zab bo nyams su longs dang gsal// // sha chen la brten rmi lam ni// sha chen btab pa'i 'jam 'thung nas// srod la bab tshe gnyid log khar// 'byung bzhi thim rim ngos bzung nas// dran med gnyid du 'gro kha ru// mthong thos la sogs yul snang kun/ swāp+nan+d+ra rmi lam nyid du sbyang*// gnyid nas rmi lam zin par 'gyur// de tshe sprul dang sgyur ba sogs// gang 'dod nyin snang bsres la sbyang*// 'khrul ba rang zad 'di kho na// // bar do rtags kyis bsgom pa ni// nyin gyi snang ba ji snyed pa// bar do nyid yin bsams la 'bad// de tshe swāp+na rmi lam nyid du// 'khrul snang bar dor shar ba na// bar do zin pa'i rtags su bshad// 'di ni mi 'gyur gnad kyi gzer// de ltar byung tshe bar do'i chos// lam 'khyer gzhan ltar sbyangs pa na// bar dor 'khrul phyir mi 'brang ba/ /nga yi gnyan po 'dzugs chos so/ // sgyu lus chu la sbyang ba ni// rang mdun snod du chu dwangs bzhag /de nang ba da na gdong mthong tshe// snang la rang bzhin med pa dang*| |rang nyid ji bzhin byed pa ltar// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin snod bcud rnams// med bzhin snang ba de ltar snang*// de dag sgyu ma ji bzhin rtogs// de rjes 'brangs pa de dag la| |bstod smad dga' sdug ci la yod// de bzhin bdag la gzhan dag gis// bstod smad byed pa'ang de ltar rtogs// de bzhin tshe 'di'i snang ba kun// chu nang bzhin du sbyangs pa'i rtags| |gnyis bsdus chos kun sgyu ma ltar// snang la rang bzhin ma grub par// sbyangs pa'i stobs kyis shugs la 'char// de lta'i bcos ma la goms na// bcos min ngang du de grol lo| |de ltar lam zab bla sgrub kyi/

/zab gnad 'ga' zhig sbas tshul gyi// dam pa'i zhal la rag lus pa/ /yi ger 'bri ba ma gnang ba// da lta tshig don gnad rnams ni// blo mtshor cher cher gsal na yang*// blo gros dman zhing sbyang stobs kyi| |mthu chung las dbang nyon yid kyis// bsgribs nas brjed 'jigs sa dpyad tsam// yi ge'i srad bu la bstar gyi// 'di rnams kyis ni nges pa'i gnad// man ngag zhib bshad lag len bcas// dam pa'i gsung gi nyi 'od kyis// blo gros mun pa ma bsal na// des mthong srin bu me khyer gyis// rmongs mun sel ba ga la srid// ces pa'i zab gnad zhal gyi bcud// chos kyi grags pa'i blo mtsho las// sa bcad nor bu'i phreng ba 'di// byung gi shes ldan blo gros kyi// rgyal mtshan rtse mor 'chang ba na| |dam pa'i gsung gi byi dor gyi/ /zhib byas gus pas gsol btab na/ /'dod don tshegs med 'byin par nges// 'di dge puṇ+ḍa ri ka ltar// dkar ba'i dngos kun dang ba'i blos// pha mar gyur ba'i 'gro ba kun// rdo rje snyems ma gang de dang*| |dga' mgur spyod pa'i sa thob shog/ //maṅga laṃ//
